cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && rm -f /tmp/ai_blocks.log && nohup bash -c "
python3 scripts/make_blocks_cloud.py >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log 2>&1
echo "--- claude blocks done ---" >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log
python3 scripts/make_video.py >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log 2>&1
echo "--- claude video done ---" >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log
python3 scripts/make_blocks_gemini_cloud.py >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log 2>&1
echo "--- gemini blocks done ---" >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log
python3 scripts/make_video.py gemini >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log 2>&1
echo "--- gemini video done ---" >> /tmp/ai_blocks.log
" > /tmp/ai_blocks_wrapper.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"
